findings.claim: Linde AG 前少數股東在慕尼黑法院的擠出補償價格訴訟：2023-11 法院駁回全部請求，原告已上訴；另與 RCA 的俄羅斯專案糾紛仍在 HKIAC 仲裁中，St. Petersburg 禁令未解除。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 8 附註
findings.excerpt: In November 2023, the court issued a decision rejecting the plaintiffs’ claims in their entirety and determining that the cash merger squeeze-out consideration was appropriate. The plaintiffs have appealed this decision.
